decisions.reason: A dedicated business unit for offshore and renewable energy was publicly announced and given its own page, so it reflects substantial investment and fits the firm's stated direction toward cleaner shipping, which makes dropping it costly to justify.

Crew and corporate travel management builds directly on the firm's large crew operations and has its own page, so the firm is publicly committed to it, and any pandemic-era weakness in travel can be attributed to temporary causes.

The online vessel information portal is a visible digital offering that is integrated with customer service and supports the firm's announced direction, so writing it off would expose the earlier investment as a mistake.

The mobile performance app took less investment and could be folded into the portal, but it was presented publicly and supports the firm's efficiency and sustainability narrative, so it is more likely to be kept than dropped.
